name: scafld.verify
description: Verify one signed scafld receipt against an exact commit with the scafld CLI on PATH: the scafld connector's receipt.verify implementation.

receipt_path.description: The receipt file, relative to repo_root or absolute within it.

target.description: Exact commit the receipt must verify against.

repo_root.description: Repository root the receipt was finalized in, relative to the workspace.
